application.name: Qase — Autonomous QA Agent
application.description: Self-hosted, single-tenant autonomous QA agent: LLM-driven agent drives real Chromium against an allowlisted target, files structured findings, generates test cases, replays workflows as regression suites, self-heals selectors, validates fixes.
application.runtime: Node.js >= 20, ES modules, Express 5, no TypeScript, no frontend framework

architecture.pattern: single process; Express app + SDK agent runtime + file-based JSON persistence via atomicWrite

frontend.auth_flow: first-run token gate -> token stored in localStorage qase_token -> fetch wrapper adds Bearer
limitations: no virtualization for very large lists
heavy session detail gated behind full=1

backend.concurrency: missionGovernor FIFO, 1 concurrent agent mission; suite runs have separate concurrency; scheduler 60s tick
backend.persistence: JSON files in .qase/ via atomicWrite (temp+rename); no SQL/Redis in use

authentication.instance_token: IMPLEMENTED — Bearer header / qase_token cookie (refresh-only) / ?token= query; timing-safe; gates all /api except public routes
authentication.integration_hmac: IMPLEMENTED — QASE-HMAC-SHA256 over method+path+timestamp+nonce+sha256(body); scopes; workspace matching; principals in .qase/integrations.json
authentication.spa_gate: IMPLEMENTED — first-run token gate; localStorage qase_token
authentication.read_only_token: NOT IMPLEMENTED (full read/write token only; options documented)

security.ssrf_targetguard: IMPLEMENTED — allowlist at ingest + CDP page/redirect boundaries + webhook URL validation
security.secret_vault: IMPLEMENTED — session-scoped; agent sees {{PLACEHOLDER}}s; redactor scrubs leaks
security.secret_storage: config: .qase/config.json (BrowserStack key plaintext-at-rest today, masked in all API responses); LLM key in platform-managed .env
security.webhook_signing: IMPLEMENTED — HMAC-SHA256 signatures, backoff retries max 5, persisted deliveries
security.csrf: NOT IMPLEMENTED (mitigated: no CORS, Bearer-only auth, cookie never granted to anonymous)

llm.direct_calls: testGen.js callLLM -> {baseUrl}/chat/completions (120s timeout, 2 retries): workflow->test-cases, finding root-cause, app improvement report, self-heal selector, feature-gap enhancement, app-understanding reasoning
llm.gateway_in_use: platform-configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint (value in env, not in docs)
llm.role_separation: NOT IMPLEMENTED (single model tier; C5 roadmap)

autonomy.decision_engine: deterministic rule cascade (CONTINUE/REVALIDATE/REPLAN/STOP) — no LLM in decisions
autonomy.mid_session_probe: C3 — every 4 turns; authority=NONE (hint or early-stop request only)
autonomy.budget: maxTurns clamp 1-500; hard abort in agent loop; turn-pool debits; autonomy layer can never raise maxTurns (source-tested)

browser_automation.evidence: screenshots, traces, console, network via evidence graph

browserstack.status: PARTIAL — probe + test-case replay execution exist; agent/mission execution does NOT exist
browserstack.connection_test: 2-stage probe (Basic-auth plan.json + CDP WS handshake); no Automate minutes burned
browserstack.strict_mode: BrowserStackStrictError on failure; non-strict falls back to local with loud warning
browserstack.c4_productionization: NOT BUILT — working-tree implementation lost in 2026-08-27 container restart; spec at .drytis/specs/C4-browserstack-production.md

storage.type: file-based JSON (.qase/) with atomicWrite; artifacts under .qase/artifacts/
storage.sql_or_redis: none in use (platform MySQL provisioned, stopped by design)
storage.cleanup: storeHygiene (dry-run/guarded); artifacts cleanup diagnostics; sessions pruned to 50

evidence.graph: evidenceGraph.js — exploration->evidence->findings->assessment->decision edges; integrity verify; coverage; pruning

findings.lifecycle: session finding -> global sync (missionId stamped) -> deterministic enrichment (severity/category/root-cause with reasons) -> duplicate detection -> human review -> fix validation -> resolved/reopened
safeguards: feature-gap findings require explicit-expectation evidence (C3 gate)
fix status derived only by deterministic fixStatusEngine

regression.self_heal: selector-failure detection -> DOM snapshot -> LLM selector proposal -> patch
regression.fix_validation: finding-derived validation case, N attempts (default 2), verdicts VERIFIED_FIXED/STILL_BROKEN/PARTIALLY_FIXED/REGRESSED
regression.scheduling: cron schedules -> replay suites; manual trigger; trends

testing.benchmarks: python3 scripts/serve-benchmarks.py serves :9901-9907 (required for device/browser tests)
testing.env_requirements: QASE_BASE_URL=http://localhost:5173 for tests (app .env sets it to the LLM endpoint); QASE_API_TOKEN loaded

production.health: healthy; /openapi.json 200 (verified 2026-08-29; transient 502 observed once during pod reschedule, self-healed)
production.known_gap: servers[0].url advertises internal host until prod QASE_PUBLIC_URL set

deployment.deploy_flow: verify on dev -> commit+push -> platform config push -> rolling restart -> smoke checks
deployment.warning: container restart resets workspace to last pushed commit — uncommitted work is destroyed (incident: 2026-08-27)

configuration.sources_precedence: stored config (.qase/config.json via Settings) overrides env for LLM provider fields; env seeds; .env platform-managed (never hand-edit)

quick_start: configure env (platform env-keys or .env; LLM provider fields + QASE_API_TOKEN)
open http://localhost:5173 -> paste instance token at the gate
create a session targeting http://127.0.0.1:9901/ (or any allowlisted URL)
watch the run live; review findings + evidence
python3 scripts/serve-benchmarks.py & ; QASE_BASE_URL=http://localhost:5173 npm run test:gate
